question: To whom is the determination of Raktapāla said to apply, described as delighting in the practice of yoga?
premises: Those delighting in the practice of yoga are named as object.
inference: The determination of Raktapāla indeed applies to those delighting in the practice of yoga.
uncertainties: The verbal relation linking them is not explicit in this verse.
plain_english: Indeed, to those delighting in the practice of yoga, the determination of Raktapāla applies.
